content: Anthropic Trademark Guidelines (effective 2024-08-01): marks usable only as specifically permitted and in pre-approved materials; no implied sponsorship/endorsement; page is silent on nominative 'for Claude' use. Consumer Terms (effective 2025-10-08) s.12: no use of name/logos/trademarks without prior written permission or implying affiliation; s.3 prohibits automated/non-human access (bot, script) except via API key or where explicitly permitted, crawling/scraping/harvesting, bypassing protective measures, building competing products; s.7 third-party integrations at user's own risk. Secondary reports of enforcement against sound-alike names (Clawdbot rename).
